mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal stagflationary conditions that compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with concurrent FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%), a decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5% and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for RSAFS signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic distress that reduces earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing recovery regimes (HOUST > 650.0 thousand units), a decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer confidence that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST > 650.0 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for HOUST decline signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year window.
